# eSIM.dog: full product and price catalogue

> Prepaid travel eSIMs with fixed data allowances, daily high-speed allowances, configurable unlimited plans and regional coverage.

Price snapshot: 2026-11-09. Currency: USD. Each price is for the complete stated package or billing period. Tax may be added at checkout as shown on the product page.

## Products and help
- Country plans: fixed data, or a selectable number of days for unlimited plans. https://esim.dog/
- Regional plans: packages covering several countries. Coverage is listed with each group below. https://esim.dog/regions
- WorldPass: global data subscription. https://esim.dog/worldpass
  - 1 Month: $30/mo, billed monthly;initial payment USD 30.00.
  - 3 Months: $15/mo for 3 months, then $25/mo;initial payment USD 45.00.
  - 12 Months: $15/mo, billed $180 yearly;initial payment USD 180.00.
- UK phone number subscriptions: https://esim.dog/numbers
  - 1 month: USD 3.99 for the stated subscription period.
  - 3 months: USD 5.29 for the stated subscription period.
  - 12 months: USD 11.39 for the stated subscription period.
- In-flight and cruise data packages: https://esim.dog/special
- VPN: https://esim.dog/vpn
- Installation help: https://esim.dog/help
- Terms and refund conditions: https://esim.dog/terms
- Customer reviews: https://esim.dog/reviews

## Reading the catalogue
Fixed tables: data is the total allowance, days is the total validity, USD is the complete package price. The data parameter is the exact value for the purchase link. Replace the braces in each link template using the selected row;keep the other parameters unchanged.
Unlimited price lists use days=USD. Each amount buys the whole stated number of days. A daily high-speed allowance resets each day;it is not a single allowance shared across the trip. Price rows for every supported integer duration are included.
Blue, Black, Green, Yellow and Pink identify the options displayed on eSIM.dog. Amber Essential fixed plans have a 1 Mbps speed cap and do not include hotspot. Purple fully unlimited plans use the speed stated for that group.
The fixed-plan links select the eSIM without a VPN add-on.
